name: Earth Planetary Sciences (PMn)

rules.name: PhD minor coursework (20 units)

children.name: Six approved letter-graded courses numbered 200 or above

rules.desc:
All Ph.D. Minor students must complete a minimum of 6 letter-graded graduate-level courses (200-level or above), totaling at least 20 units, by the end of their PhD program. These courses must be approved by the EPS Director of Graduate Studies and the Department Chair.
Please reach out to the EPS Student Service Team for more information on how to apply.

gpa: University grade point average (GPA) of 3.0 (B) or higher
grading:
Students must earn letter grades in all graduate-level courses that count toward program requirements (not including EPS 400 Graduate Research).
General University Grading System: https://studentservices.stanford.edu/my-academics/evaluations-exams-grades/grades/general-university-grading-system
Students are responsible for checking their final grades at the end of each quarter. If incomplete grades (I), Grade Not Reported (GNR), or No Credit (NC) appear on the end-of-quarter grade report, students should immediately check with their instructor. The Assistant Director of Student Services can assist students and instructors in clearing missing and incomplete grades by forwarding the appropriate instructions and/or university forms.
transferPolicy: PhD minor degree students are not eligible for transfer residency credit.
reviewNotes: The minor is at least six letter-graded courses numbered 200 or above, totaling at least 20 units, approved by the EPS Director of Graduate Studies and the Department Chair; with no list, you move the approved courses in, and a course without a letter grade does not count. Your advisor checks the 3.0 GPA, and transfer units do not count.
